editions.title: King James Version · standardized 1769 text with Apocrypha (eng-kjv)
editions.credit: KJV translators; electronic source from CrossWire Bible Society and eBible.org.
editions.rights: Public domain outside the UK. Source notes UK Crown letters-patent restrictions on printing and importing printed copies.
editions.numbering: eBible.org eng-kjv source chapter and verse labels. KJV Rest of Esther uses chapters10–16.

editions.title: World English Bible · Updated, American English (engwebp)
editions.credit: World English Bible contributors and eBible.org.
editions.rights: Public domain. World English Bible is a trademark; wording retained.
editions.numbering: eBible.org engwebp source chapter and verse labels. Joined verse ranges preserved, not split artificially.

editions.title: The Book of Enoch · R. H. Charles 1917
editions.credit: R. H. Charles, SPCK 1917, tenth impression 1962; Project Gutenberg 77935 transcription. Translation reprints Charles 1912.
editions.rights: Public-domain underlying translation in the United States; Project Gutenberg reuse terms and local-law notice accompany source. No claim of a modern Geʿez or official Tewahedo edition.
editions.numbering: Charles 1917 printed chapters 1–108. Source subdivisions/reordered verse chunks are combined into labeled ranges without guessing splits; e.g. 5:6–7,51:2–5,91:12–19.

editions.title: Jubilees · R. H. Charles 1913
editions.credit: R. H. Charles, The Apocrypha and Pseudepigrapha of the Old Testament, Oxford 1913; scanned and corrected by Joshua Williams, Northwest Nazarene College, c. 1995; CCEL transcription.
editions.rights: Public domain; corresponding CrossWire Jubilees module identifies this transcription and distribution license as Public Domain. This transcription’s ordered-list numbering is retained; no equivalence to another edition’s verse numbering is inferred.
editions.numbering: CCEL Charles 1913 chapter pages 1–50 and ordered verse lists.

editions.title: The Ethiopic Didascalia · J. M. Harden 1920
editions.credit: J. M. Harden, translated from Ethiopic, SPCK / Macmillan, 1920. Ertale transcription from the Cornell / Internet Archive scan cu31924096083336, with OCR corrections.
editions.rights: Public-domain 1920 translation. Scan identified as public domain by Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Ethiopic_Didascalia_(IA_cu31924096083336).pdf . Transcription source identifies the text as public domain. OCR errors may remain.
editions.numbering: 43 source chapters, no intrinsic verse divisions. Internal block 1 stores the whole chapter and is not a verse. Chapter-only references are supported; no cross-edition verse mapping is asserted.

editions.title: Te’ezaz · Ethiopic Statutes · George Horner 1904
editions.credit: George Horner, The Statutes of the Apostles (Williams & Norgate,1904), English translation from Ethiopic, pp.127–232. Ertale electronic transcription. Work identification: Ran HaCohen, Tel Aviv University, https://www.tau.ac.il/~hacohen/Tezaz/Information.html .
editions.rights: Public-domain historical1904 translation; transcription identifies the source as public domain. OCR-derived text may retain errors.
editions.numbering: 73 browser sections: printed statutes1–72, including two40s. Browser41 = second40;42–73 = printed41–72. Chapter-only references. Appended unnumbered liturgical prayers are not included in this electronic edition.

editions.title: Gitsew · Ethiopic Apostolic Canons · George H. Schodde 1885
editions.credit: George H. Schodde, The Apostolic Canons, Translated from the Ethiopic, Journal of the Society of Biblical Literature and Exegesis5 (1885),61–72. Translation of Fell’s Ethiopic text; Ertale electronic transcription. Identity reference: Mikre-Sellassie1993, The Bible and its Canon in the Ethiopian Orthodox Church, notes47–48.
editions.rights: Public-domain1885 historical translation, JSTOR Early Journal Content / Internet Archive scan jstor-3268629. OCR-derived transcription may retain errors.
editions.numbering: 57 canons I–LVII become browser chapters1–57, each as unversified prose. Traditional56-canon enumeration differs in segmentation at the close; no automatic cross-edition numbering equivalence is asserted.

coverageChecks.check: 108 source chapter numbers present; all printed numeric and lettered verse markers parsed. Front matter, headings, page numbers, footnotes, two editorial blocks and colophon excluded. Reordered/subdivided source verse chunks combined into labeled ranges preserving source wording order; not arbitrarily split.

All50 chapter pages verified against [Chapter n] and ordered-list item boundaries. CCEL list numbering is the reading numbering; no unverified equivalence with other Jubilees versifications is asserted. Introductions and chapter summaries excluded. Unnumbered prologue and concluding subscription stored separately, not represented as verses.

43 chapter pages match the source index and 43 chapter headings in the 1920 scan. Whole chapters stored as unversified reading blocks, not numbered biblical verses. Introduction, cross-reference apparatus, footnotes and Additional Notes excluded by the transcription. OCR-derived source may retain errors; not a critical edition.

All73 source sections imported. Horner has statutes1–72 with two consecutive40s; browser41 is the second40, browser42–73 correspond to printed41–72. Complete numbered legislative text of the Ethiopic translation; appended unnumbered liturgical prayer cycle is outside this electronic edition. No Coptic/Arabic text substituted. OCR artefacts may remain.

57 numbered canons, I–LVII, checked against the 1885 journal scan and the 57 source transcription blocks. Canon numbers become browser chapter numbers; each canon is unversified prose. This is the Ethiopic recension translated by Schodde from Fell, not the Greek85/Coptic81 recension. Introduction and translator apparatus excluded.

notes: Complete means every numbered source chapter and source verse block is imported, not a claim of textual perfection or identical versification across editions.
Enoch has108 textual chapters, not115 website sections; Jubilees has50 textual chapters, not89 website sections.
No introductions, editorial headings, footnotes or commentary are emitted as verses.
Unnumbered prologue and subscription for Jubilees are stored separately, not numbered as verses.
